author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk to make rehab start Friday
desc: Janson Junk will make his second rehab start for Triple-A Jacksonville on Friday.
impact: Junk had X-rays return negative after getting injured on his rehab assignment. He will likely be activated after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Pomeranz to join Cubs in majors
desc: The Cubs are calling up Drew Pomeranz.
impact: Pomeranz had signed a minor league contract with the Cubs. Jordan Wicks was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Wicks officially optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Cubs optioned Jordan Wicks to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: The move was reported on Thursday and becomes official on Friday. Drew Pomeranz was called up as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Gusto optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Marlins optioned Ryan Gusto to Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Gusto will return to Triple-A with William Kempner getting called up.

author: Ari Koslow
title: William Kempner recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Marlins recalled William Kempner from Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Kempner will add a fresh arm for Miami heading into the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rob Zastryzny (trap) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Brewers say Rob Zastryzny will begin a rehab assignment in the Arizona Complex League on Friday.
impact: Zastryzny will figure to make a handful of rehab appearances before he is activated later in July.

author: Nate Miller
title: Franco Aleman heads back to bigs
desc: Franco Aleman was recalled by the Guardians ahead of Friday's game against the White Sox.
impact: Aleman made a pair of relief appearances with the Guardians back in May, giving up one run on three hits and one walk with one strikeout across 2 2/3 innings. The 26-year-old righty has been impressively dominant for Triple-A Columbus this year, surrendering only one earned run while posting a 43-7 K/BB ratio across 28 1/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Tanner Banks to be recalled from minors
desc: Tanner Banks will be called up from Triple-A before Saturday's game in Kansas City.
impact: Alan Rangel was optioned back to Triple-A following Thursday's start, so Banks will be brought up to add depth to the Philly bullpen. Banks has spent most of the season with the Phillies, struggling to a 5.86 ERA and 1.92 WHIP over 26 appearances.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ian Hamilston designated for assignment
desc: Ian Hamilton was designated for assignment following Thursday's loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Hamilton gave up a run on three hits over 1 2/3 innings in Thursday's loss. He's pitched fairly well since being called up just over a week ago, allowing only one run over three appearances. However, he will now hit the waiver wire, as the Braves call up other bullpen options.

author: Nate Miller
title: James Karinchak heads back to minors
desc: James Karinchak was optioned back to Triple-A Gwinnett ahead of Friday's game against the Mets.
impact: Karinchak has given up a run in each of his last two appearances, including Thursday's outing. However, the 30-year-old righty has pitched well since originally being called up a few weeks ago, posting a 2.08 ERA and 0.92 WHIP over eight appearances. It would not be surprising to see him back in the Braves' bullpen relatively soon.

author: Nate Miller
title: Danny Young (elbow) activated from IL
desc: Danny Young (elbow) was activated from the IL ahead of Friday's game against the Mets.
impact: Young will join the Braves at the start of a series against his former club. The lefty, who signed with the Braves this past December, worked in 10 games for the Mets last season, putting up a 4.32 ERA and 13-3 K/BB ratio across 8 1/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Anthony Molina heads back to bigs
desc: Anthony Molina was recalled from Triple-A Gwinnett on Friday.
impact: Molina will rejoin the Braves' bullpen ahead of Friday's series opener against the Mets. The 24-year-old righty has made three appearances for the Braves this season, giving up four runs (three earned) over five innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Dominic Smith drives in three runs Thursday evening
desc: Dominic Smith went 1-for-4 with a three-run double in Thursday's 11-5 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: With the Braves facing an early three-run deficit, their offense briefly came to life in the first inning Thursday, scoring five while bringing 10 batters to the plate. Smith delivered the big knock of the inning, as he stepped up with the bases loaded and rifled a liner off the foot of St. Louis pitcher Dustin May. The ball would ricochet all the way into right field and clear the bases. Smith is now up to 35 RBI on the year, and perhaps he can snap out of a long cold streak.

author: Nate Miller
title: Hurston Waldrep recovers after shaky first inning
desc: Hurston Waldrep allowed three runs on five hits and one walk while striking out four over 5 1/3 innings in Thursday's 11-5 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Waldrep made his first start of the season for the Braves on Thursday, and just his second appearance overall after spending the first few months on the IL. The young righty had a rocky first inning, letting the first two Cardinals hitters to reach base before serving up a three-run homer to Jordan Walker later in the frame. However, Waldrep impressively recovered over the next four-plus innings, keeping the Cardinals' bats from adding any additional runs. Expectations remain high for Waldrep after he posted a 2.88 ERA and 1.19 WHIP with 55 strikeouts across 56 1/3 innings as a rookie in 2025.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jacob Misiorowski provides mixed results on mound in loss to Reds
desc: Jacob Misiorowski allowed five runs (one earned) on five hits while striking out 10 over five innings in Thursday's loss to the Reds.
impact: Misiorowski continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, striking out seven or more in each of his last 13 trips to the mound. The right-hander continues to reward fantasy managers with an elite starting option at the top of the Brewers rotation, carrying a 1.47 ERA and 0.78 WHIP with a 9-4 record and 13.5 K/9 ratio across 17 starts.
